api.decode: decode_selected_files(pack: bytes, commit_sha: str, paths: Sequence[str], *, cancelled: Callable[[], bool] | None = None, deadline: float | None = None) -> GitContentResult
api.repr: selected paths, content bytes and files tuple excluded; safe SHA-1 identities and counts only

accepted: Raw complete SHA-1 PACK version 2 or 3 with one checksum trailer
Undeltified commit/tree/blob and self-contained OFS_DELTA/REF_DELTA, including forward REF bases and mixed/deltified chains
Copy instructions with optional noncontiguous little-endian offset/size bytes, zero-size default 65536, and nonzero literal insertion
Unique canonical SHA-1 identities with valid commit/tree structure, extension-header signature continuation lines
Exact selected immutable lowercase 40-hex commit, exact normalized UTF-8 POSIX paths through present trees to 100644/100755 regular blobs
Unselected tree entries may be symlink/gitlink modes but are never traversed; selected symlink/gitlink entries reject the entire request
History parents and unselected tree targets may be absent; all delta bases and all selected path objects must exist
rejected: SHA-256, PACK versions outside 2/3, tags/reserved object kinds, empty packs, protocol pkt-line or side-band framing
External thin bases, unresolved cyclic dependencies, duplicate canonical identities or tree names, noncanonical tree ordering
Truncated/header/varint/zlib streams, incorrect declared or reconstructed sizes, invalid delta opcodes/copy ranges, checksum failure, trailing bytes
Missing or mismatched selected commit/tree/blob identities, malformed commit/tree headers/entries, null tree/parent IDs, duplicate parent IDs
Non-normalized, duplicate, empty, absolute, control-containing, backslash or reserved .git path components; excessive path length/depth
Selected symlink/gitlink/directory, standard Git LFS version pointer prefix, all resource-limit violations, cancellation, deadline expiry
Provider network/authentication, object databases, filesystem objects/temporary packs, hooks/filters/submodules/LFS execution are outside this API
resource_notes: Object and cumulative declared inflated sizes reserved before zlib expansion; every intermediate delta result reserved before reconstruction
Output chunks <=65536 bytes; at most one bounded overflow-detection scratch byte, allowed only with aggregate headroom; malformed size never retained
All delta copy and insert boundaries validated before slice/extend; no recursive delta call stack
Expansion counters measure logical inflated payloads plus every reconstructed delta result, not a process RSS ceiling or Python allocator accounting
Cancelled/deadline checks at object, inflate-chunk, dependency-pass, delta-instruction, commit-header, tree-entry and selected-path checkpoints
